meta.notes: ~25 messy real-person queries, ROMANCE+FAMILY+FRIENDS register, zh-first with some English/Manglish. Stress-test router: typos, voice2text homophones, emoji, ellipsis, passive-aggressive tone, plus 4 (none) traps.

cases.q: 他三天没回我消息了 是不是不喜欢我了😭
cases.why: Dating anxiety over reply silence, romance register with emoji, no punctuation.

cases.q: 我妈又在饭桌上催婚 我说一句她顶十句 怎么办
cases.why: Classic parental nagging standoff, family scenario, casual vent phrasing.

cases.q: how to tell my best friend she has been ignoring me and it hurts
cases.why: English-lane friendship hurt/confrontation, half-sentence lowercase style.

cases.q: 男生回哦哦是什么意思 在线等
cases.why: Pure decode request of a terse incoming message, S1 shape.

cases.q: wtf 我闺蜜居然跟我ex出去吃饭 她到底什么意思
cases.why: Betrayal-tinged friend drama, angry register, no question mark.

cases.q: 女朋友说没事 她真的没事吗
cases.why: Textbook 没事 implicature: stated meaning contradicts intended meaning.

cases.q: 想跟他谈结婚 但他每次都转移话题 这话到底怎么开得了口啊。。
cases.why: Dreaded-conversation opener request, trailing 。。 ellipsis, partner framing.

cases.q: 我朋友借了我三千块在也不提了怎么开口要回来啊
cases.why: Run-on unpunctuated speech-to-text, homophone 在/再, awkward money ask.

cases.q: 刚match到的girl怎么开场 不想只会说hi
cases.why: Dating-app icebreaker for romantic match, mixed zh+en flirty register.

cases.q: 我弟又偷玩我手机 说了八百遍了 我真的要炸了
cases.why: Sibling boundary violation, hyperbole 我要炸了, angry family register.

cases.q: 室友的碗永远不洗 呵呵 我是不是太好欺负了
cases.why: Sarcasm marker 呵呵 + self-pity, passive-aggressive roommate grievance.

cases.q: 老婆突然发了个🌹😊然后就没下文了 我是不是做错啥了
cases.why: Decoding emoji-only message behaviour on chat app, messaging-channel question.

cases.q: 跟天蝎男谈恋爱好累 他们是不是都这么记仇
cases.why: Zodiac-sign heuristic used to read a partner, exactly the c8 folk-heuristic lane.

cases.q: 我infj他estp 为什么我们聊天永远不同频 求解
cases.why: MBTI abbreviations as the framing for partner mismatch, typology entry point.

cases.q: 我妈句句『我都是为你好』听得我好内疚 这算不算pua
cases.why: Guilt-trip recognition request, manipulation-vocabulary (pua) from a layperson.

cases.q: 朋友的爸爸过世了 我只会说节哀 到底还能讲什么
cases.why: Condolence wording beyond 节哀, grief-support scenario, sombre tone.

cases.q: 爸妈天天吵 我夹在中间快疯了 到底要怎么劝
cases.why: Third-party stuck-in-the-middle mediation within family, distressed register.

cases.q: 『行 那你以后都别来找我了』这句发出去会不会太冲 帮我改改
cases.why: User drafting a pointed reply and asking for a rewrite, S2 reply-engine shape.

cases.q: 马来同事请我去他家open house 我要带什么 注意什么 才不会失礼
cases.why: Malay cultural etiquette for visiting a friend's open house, Malaysia-specific lane.

cases.q: 咋哄女朋有啊 在线等挺急的
cases.why: Keyboard typo 女朋有 for 女朋友, meme-phrase 在线等挺急的, urgency framing.

cases.q: 我总控制不住跟家人讲话很大声 讲完又后悔 怎么改
cases.why: Emotion regulation failure with family, self-improvement ask, EI territory.

cases.q: 2026年马来西亚长假怎么拼 怎么请年假最划算
cases.why: Leave-planning logistics, zero communication content; router must not grab sc3 via 家.

cases.q: 帮我算下 房贷利率4.2%借35万 月供多少
cases.why: Mortgage arithmetic request, no interpersonal dimension at all.

cases.q: 最近狂掉头发 吃什么维生素比较好 有推荐的吗
cases.why: Health/vitamin question; must not be lured into sc18-medical-communication which is doctor talk.

cases.q: 唉 好累 就想找人说说话 没啥事
cases.why: Pure vent with no ask; nothing to decode or reply to, router should not force a topic.
